evidence.quote: the corresponding $\alpha$ conversion factors remain constant within 10% for volume density up to $10^4$ cm$^{-3}$ and kinetic temperature in the range 10–100 K.

method.value: Ratios of integrated opacities with pivot species (NH2 for NH/NH3, H2-18O for H2O), OPR and time-variation corrections

evidence.quote: Further assuming NH$_2$/NH$_3$=1, as we have discussed above, we end up with the ratio NH$_2$D/NH$_3$ $\sim 3 \times 10^{-3}$.

findings_qualitative.value: v~-4 km/s component is chemically peculiar (enhanced CH3OH, N2H+, SO2), variable on months timescales, possibly a cold dark cloud analog

evidence.quote: Overall, these properties suggest that the $v = -4$  km s$^{-1}$ component could be associated with a cold dark cloud similar to those in the Milky Way.

findings_qualitative.value: First detection of SO2 toward PKS 1830-211

evidence.quote: which represents the first detection of SO$_2$ toward PKS 1830$-$211

claims.hypothesis: Deuterated molecules are detectable in the z=0.89 absorber
claims.experiment: ALMA band 6/7 absorption spectra toward the SW image
claims.result: ND, NH2D and HDO detected; fractionation up to ~1e-3
claims.finding: First detection of deuterated species other than HD in this absorber, ~100x primordial D/H in a narrow component

evidence.quote: with a deuterium fractionation $\sim 100$ times over the primordial D/H.

claims.hypothesis: Deuterium fractionation differs between velocity components
claims.experiment: Gaussian decomposition and ratios per component
claims.result: v=+5 component lower by about one order of magnitude

evidence.quote: Another weaker velocity component shows deuterium fractionation that is lower by an order of magnitude.

claims.hypothesis: The -4 km/s component is a cold dense cloud
claims.experiment: Compare profiles of many species and time variability
claims.result: Enhanced CH3OH, N2H+, SO2; factor 2 variability in months
claims.finding: Speculated to be analog of Galactic dark cloud

evidence.quote: we speculate that this velocity component could be associated with the analog of a Galactic dark cloud.

claims.hypothesis: LiH is detectable in molecular absorbers
claims.experiment: 7LiH (1-0) spectrum toward PKS 1830-211 and archival B0218+357
claims.finding: Earlier tentative detections toward B0218+357 likely spurious; <1e-4 of Li in LiH

evidence.quote: the non-detection of $^7$LiH yields a stringent upper limit LiH/H$_2$ $< 4 \times 10^{-13}$ (3$\sigma$)
